items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: Somebody had the name of Tunstall or something, a name like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's Anderson. Yeah, he was up at the hall the other night when I came to talk to you. He was up at the hall the other night. Yeah, I work with him. I was like, yes.

Well, there's one question while I think I was going to ask. It might be your brother. Somebody seems to... told me about that somebody had some cylinder, made some cylinder records. You remember those little tiny round records that go around about the size of a glass and they go on a machine? Somebody made some of those here a long time ago. Somebody said when you all were kids they had them. Somebody had the name of Tunstall or something, a name like that. Tunstall. Tunstall, I don't know how you pronounce it.…

Yeah, on the type of this mic. Round cylinder. I can't recall that, but I can't recall who it was with now. But I can picture what you're speaking about. It was just about the size of this glass. And it was just like if you was playing in one of those old time photographs.
